scope: standalone Cell CPU, not native egglog
limits: Three interleaved samples per lane, one warmup; all retained. Background system/application activity was present. Whole-process average cores includes load/export and is not inference utilization. Eight workers also raise the filter admission threshold from 1024 to 2048 rows. No thread scaling or overall speedup established.

sampling.trigger: first source Run in progress log
sampling.limits: Sampling includes wall-time residence on parked threads; stack counts are not CPU percentages. Symbolication time is included in command end. Logging and sampling perturb this diagnostic.

profile.limits: Separate five-second sampled window; stack residence, not CPU time. Inclusive counts overlap; logging and sampling perturb the run.
